question: Which students manage to generate the highest income. State his/her full name along with the income source.
evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; generate the highest income refers to MAX(income.amount);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2 FROM (SELECT T1.first_name AS c0, T1.last_name AS c1, T2.source AS c2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) DESC) AS __r FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.source) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.source FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.source ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: List the full name and income source for every student whose income record has an amount equal to the maximum income amount, including all ties
b.sql: SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, i.source AS income_source FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM income)
